# The key set and the value types each Murmure SCHEMA_VERSION writes
# (`MURMURE-437`).
#
# One section per version, one line per path, each naming the type the value
# under it holds. A path starts with the document kind, because a channel is
# several documents. `*` stands for a list index, `{id}` for a map key that is an
# identifier, and `text` for a LoroText.
#
# Generated by `schema_shape`, never by hand. A section is frozen: a build whose
# shape no longer matches its own section raises SCHEMA_VERSION and appends a
# new section. Editing a section in place is the one move this file exists to
# make visible in review.
